# Atrix Explorer

> A mobile web browser optimized for manhwa and novel readers.

## Key Information
- **App Name**: Atrix Explorer
- **Target Audience**: Readers of web novels, manhwa, webtoons, and serial fictions on Android.
- **Universal Tracking**: Keep track of your reading progress across various manhwa, manhua, and webtoon sites.
- **Reader-Focused Browser**: Includes tools and optimizations to make reading long-strip comics and novels smoother on mobile devices.
- **Library Organization**: Manage, organize, and discover new titles all from within the app.

## Resources
- Website: https://atrixexplorer.com/
